## Summary

**Feature:** startup check for newer GitHub release → snackbar with Install → background download w/ progress → launch installer + quit.

**Block 1 — IPC + preload** (`desktop/src/shell/`)
- `ipc_channels.js`: 3 new channels (`UPDATE_AVAILABLE/DOWNLOAD/PROGRESS`).
- `preload.js`: `md2Updates` bridge — `onUpdateAvailable`, `downloadUpdate(url)`, `onDownloadProgress`.
- `preload.test.mjs`: count 8→9, new bridge asserts.

**Block 2 — main service** (`desktop/src/shell/update_service.js` + test)
- Pure: `parseVersion`, `isNewerVersion` (strip `v`, numeric-segment compare), `findInstallerAsset` (`.exe`).
- `fetchLatestRelease` (injectable `https`, User-Agent header).
- `checkForUpdate`: skips when `!app.isPackaged`; sends `UPDATE_AVAILABLE {version, downloadUrl}` when newer. All errors swallowed.
- `registerUpdateDownload`: `ipcMain.handle(UPDATE_DOWNLOAD)` → stream to `os.tmpdir()` `.exe`, **4 MB `highWaterMark`**, follows 302 redirect, emits `UPDATE_PROGRESS {received,total}`, then `shell.openPath` + `app.quit()`. Errors swallowed.

**Block 3 — `main.js`**
- `createWindow` returns window; in `whenReady` register download handler + kick `checkForUpdate` with `getPrimaryWindow`.

**Block 4 — renderer**
- `data/electron_update_bridge.ts` (types + getter, null outside Electron).
- `components/shell/update_notification.tsx`: persistent Snackbar, version + Install/Dismiss; Install → `LinearProgress` from progress events → "Launching installer…" at 100%; dismiss hides until next startup. Mounted in `app.tsx`.

**Tests run (related only):** desktop `update_service` + `preload` (26 passed), app `update_notification` (6 passed), app `typecheck` clean.

Note: didn't run full suite (per instructions — manual later). One design decision worth flagging: renderer passes `downloadUrl` back through the invoke (stateless main process) rather than main caching it — spec was ambiguous there.
